title: TNT roulette
description: A mod that drops a random TNT on a random player every configurable interval, playable solo or with friends, with difficulty modes and a countdown.
body:
# 🎰 TNT Roulette

A chaotic survival mod that drops a random TNT on a random player at a configurable interval. Will it be a harmless one... or a Doomsday? Good luck.

# ⚠️ Requirements

Lucky TNT Mod 1.21 [Lucky TNT by Fleshcrafter](https://modrinth.com/mod/lucky-tnt-mod/version/6.0)

Lucky TNT Lib 1.21 [Lucky TNT Lib by Fleshcrafter](https://modrinth.com/mod/lucky-tnt-lib/version/21.0.78.2)

# 📖 How to use

/tntroulette start — Starts with 60 seconds (hard mode)

/tntroulette start <seconds> — Custom interval

/tntroulette start <seconds> easy — Only random TNT

/tntroulette start <seconds> medium — Random + Lucky TNT

/tntroulette start <seconds> hard — All TNTs including Doomsday 💀

/tntroulette stop — Stops the roulette

# 🎮 Features

Global boss bar countdown visible to all players

Random player selection each round

3 difficulty modes

Works solo or with friends

Configurable interval (5 to 3600 seconds)

**For now, it works in the overworld.**

☕ Support If you enjoy the mod, consider supporting me on [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/khoveen)

Created by @Khoveen
